solution:

__
 
• The word **"maintenence"** is misspelled and does not exist in the English language. (यह शब्द गलत है और अंग्रेजी भाषा में मौजूद नहीं है।)

 
 
• **Example:** The **maintenence** of the machine was scheduled for next week. (Incorrect)
 
 
 
• **"maintenance"** refers to the process of preserving a condition or situation or the state of being preserved. (रखरखाव)
 
 
• **Example:** Regular** maintenance** of the car is essential to ensure its longevity. (नियमित रखरखाव कार की दीर्घायु सुनिश्चित करने के लिए आवश्यक है।)
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ** maintenance**.
